meta.name: qa-engineer
meta.description: Wear the QA hat — think about quality the way a 15-year senior QA thinks. Use when building features, reviewing work, validating output, or when anything feels "done" but hasn't been proven to work. Prevents the gap between "it runs" and "it works."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证每项交付成果是否真正可用,而不只是能运行
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常在交付前心里没底,不知它是否真正可用
copy.tagline_en: Validate every deliverable to ensure it actually works, not just runs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often deliver work that runs but isn't proven to truly work.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像资深 QA 一样先弄清需求再动手，验证时不只看页面能否加载，还会检查数据关系、完整流程、错误和边缘情况，并如实报告哪些没测过。
howto.when: 当你说要构建新功能、审查代码、验证输出，或觉得某件事“做完了”但还没证实能用时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这个PR，重点检查数据关系和工作流有没有断点。
say.note: Claude 会对照需求逐项验证。

say.text: 我刚写完这个功能，请做一轮 QA 验证，别只测能跑。
say.note: 它会检查边界情况和错误状态。

say.text: 检查一下这个数据库迁移的级联删除会不会产生孤儿数据。
say.note: 它会验证关系、约束和迁移路径。

howto.what_en: Claude adopts a senior QA mindset: clarify requirements before building, verify data, workflows, error states and edge cases (not just loading), and report untested areas honestly.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build a feature, review code, validate output, or when something feels 'done' but hasn't been proven to work.

say_en.text: Review this PR, focusing on data relationships and workflow gaps.
say_en.note: Claude will verify against requirements item by item.

say_en.text: I just finished this feature. Run a QA pass beyond 'it runs'.
say_en.note: It checks edge cases and error states.

say_en.text: Check this DB migration for cascading deletes that orphan data.
say_en.note: It verifies relationships, constraints, and migration paths.
